collection_method: Manual - the user asked Grok (inside X Premium+) to search X (Top + Latest + min_faves:1) across weekly windows for ($TEL OR Telcoin OR #Telcoin OR #TEL), filtered for crypto-Telcoin relevance. Grok has live access to X's own post index, unlike this pipeline's WebSearch-based scraper, which is why this sample is larger (225 posts vs. our ~19/day) and carries real dates and real engagement numbers where WebSearch gives none. Not full volume - Grok's own notes say this represents 'engaged visible discussion,' a sample not a census, same caveat every community figure in this pipeline carries.
why_not_automated: This is a one-off manual pull, not a standing collection method. Grok chat inside X Premium+ is interactive-only (no API access included); the automatable equivalent (xAI's separate developer API with a live X-search tool, ~$5/1,000 calls) was evaluated and parked against the user's $0 budget - see campaign/AGENCY-MEMORY.md. Treat this as a periodic manual spot-check, like the analytics.x.com CSV export, not something a script will refresh.

sentiment.our_sentiment_score_formula: positive / (positive + neutral + negative) - this pipeline's standard formula (campaign/analytics/sentiment/README.md), computed here for comparability with the daily WebSearch series. Verified against the weekly breakdown before storing: 148+44+33=225, matching total_sampled_posts.
sentiment.grok_bullish_score_note: Grok's own composite figure, formula undisclosed by Grok. Deliberately NOT blended into our_sentiment_score above - this pipeline's standing rule is no single composite score hiding which input moved (see dashboard.html's 'Deliberately absent' section); the two numbers disagree (0.66 vs 0.51) precisely because they're different formulas, not because one is wrong.

engagement.views_approx_note: Grok's own label - approximate, not a platform-measured impression count. Never treat as equivalent to own_account's measured impressions.
